findings.claim: 2025年10月美國商務部將出口黑名單擴及列管公司的多數持股子公司；AMAT 預告此規則將使 FY2026 營收減少約 6 億美元，其中 FY Q4 約 1.1 億美元。
findings.source: Yahoo Finance／Reuters: Applied Materials flags $600 million revenue hit in 2026 on broader chip export curbs
findings.excerpt: Applied Materials said the change would make it more difficult to export some products and supply specific parts and services to select China-based customers without a license. It forecast a $600 million hit to fiscal 2026 revenue, and expects an impact of about $110 million on fourth-quarter revenue.

findings.claim: 該 affiliates 規則在美中領袖會談後暫停；管理層稱全年約 6 億美元銷售得以恢復，1.1 億美元延遲出貨將於至 1 月的三個月內出貨並已納入預測（次級報導，需以公司財報材料核對）。
findings.source: Yahoo Finance: Applied Materials forecasts strong quarterly (search summary, KuCoin/Yahoo)
findings.excerpt: That affiliate rule was suspended after talks between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. Executives said the suspension will re-enable about $600 million in sales for the full fiscal year.

findings.claim: 2026年2月報導 AMAT 就向中芯國際（SMIC）違規出口晶片設備達成約 2.52 億美元和解／罰款；設備經南韓子公司轉運，SMIC 於 2020年12月被列入實體清單之後出貨開始。
findings.source: TrendForce News: US reportedly hits Applied Materials with $252M penalty for illegally sending chip equipment to SMIC
findings.excerpt: SMIC's shipments reportedly began after the U.S. Commerce Department added SMIC to its "Entity List" in December 2020.

findings.claim: 2026年1月14日公告對特定先進半導體及衍生品課 25% 第232條關稅（1/15 生效），涵蓋範圍文字含半導體製造設備；豁免含美國資料中心、研發、新創、維修等用途；後續可能擴大並配套關稅抵減計畫。未找到說明 AMAT 設備是否被課徵之來源。
findings.source: White & Case: President Trump orders narrowly targeted 25% Section 232 tariff on certain advanced semiconductor articles
findings.excerpt: Any potential future tariffs would include a tariff offset program for companies investing in US semiconductor manufacturing capacity.

findings.claim: 中國占 AMAT 營收比重：聚合站稱 FY Q3 中國營收 25.1 億美元、占 28%（去年同期 35%）；CFO 稱限制影響相當於 FY2024 中國市場約 10%、FY2025 逾兩倍（次級聚合來源，未核對公司申報）。
findings.source: Yahoo Finance／Reuters 摘要: Applied Materials sees weaker China spending in 2026 on tighter US curbs
